headline: The first benchmark spans sand, cloth, cable and native cloth–cable contact. Shared-model rollouts will appear here after evaluation.

runs.title: Newton benchmark v1
runs.scope: Native reference generation and a matched cloth–cable contact ablation
runs.summary: The benchmark contains independent cloth, cable and coupled test trajectories and pinned public Newton MPM sand replays. A native falling cable loads the cloth. With cross-material contact disabled, the cable falls through and the cloth has a different final shape.

metrics.label: Benchmark episodes
metrics.detail: 32 train and 12 evaluation, including three reused public sand diagnostics

metrics.label: Cloth shape response
metrics.detail: Final native position RMS difference with cross-material contact disabled, seed 9000

metrics.label: Native support estimate
metrics.detail: Late cable reaction inferred from linear momentum, against 12.101 N weight

runs.title: Sphere support
runs.scope: Held-out sphere · recorded rigid motion · 20,646 particles · six seconds
runs.summary: The small local network reproduces active particle motion slightly better than damped contact. It predicts a deeper depression and sustained bed drift.

media.label: Newton, damped contact, directional Transolver and small local network. All panels replay the same sphere track.

runs.title: Spinning cylinder drop
runs.scope: Held-out impact · recorded rigid motion · 20,646 particles · six seconds
runs.summary: Local directional features improve active motion slightly while both learned variants predict much wider and deeper excavation than Newton.

media.label: Newton, damped contact, lattice Transolver and directional Transolver on the same cylinder replay.

comparisons.label: Public learned cable baseline
comparisons.scope: Public trajectories and checkpoint references are available for the cable simulator. A common Newton test is needed before comparing accuracy.

comparisons.label: Particle NeRD Local
comparisons.scope: A 200 Hz material and rigid-body rollout on the author's scenes. The surface mesh distance and final body depth describe separate cases.

values.label: Box free drop
values.detail: Final object center lower than MPM

comparisons.label: Cable NeRD
comparisons.scope: The benchmark will record a matched cable scene, model revision and rollout protocol when a compatible reference is available.
